recommendations.recommendation: Discriminate between the eternal and the transient, and recognize the Self as real.
recommendations.rationale: Only discernment of the real from the unreal leads to liberation.
recommendations.argued_against: Mistaking the transient body and world for the real self.

recommendations.recommendation: Renounce desire for worldly objects and cultivate dispassion.
recommendations.rationale: Attachment to objects binds the mind and hinders knowledge of the Self.

recommendations.recommendation: Develop the disciplines of inner control, self-restraint, and steady faith.
recommendations.rationale: These qualities prepare the mind to receive the teaching and to realize the Self.
recommendations.argued_against: Lack of discipline in mind and senses.

recommendations.recommendation: Seek a teacher and listen to scriptural teaching, then reflect and meditate on it.
recommendations.rationale: Knowledge of the Self comes through instruction, reflection, and meditation.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Seeking liberation without guidance or inquiry.

recommendations.recommendation: Control the mind and the senses through regular practice.
recommendations.rationale: A controlled mind can rest in the Self.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not identify yourself with the body or the ego.
recommendations.rationale: Identification with the body and ego is the root of bondage.
recommendations.argued_against: Identifying oneself with the body and ego.

recommendations.recommendation: Remain steady in the Self through all changes of fortune.
recommendations.rationale: The Self is unchanging, and knowing it brings lasting peace.
